## bizOS customization-request webhook

Path: `POST /webhook/bizos/customization-request`

Set `BIZOS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` to match bizOS `N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.
Delivery: Mailpit (`BIZOS_OPS_MAILPIT_URL`) or `BIZOS_OPS_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL`.

meta.description: Signed customization-request webhook. Delivers via Mailpit or an alert webhook.
